title: Normalize Gallery renderer adapter ownership
requires: Any development host with configured Gallery backends
scope: Place host, Vulkan and Metal Gallery renderers behind one common adapter and factory boundary and make CMake target ownership match that runtime boundary.
acceptance: Gallery clients select rendering through the common adapter contract and platform applications do not construct or reach through private backend renderer types.
The CMake target graph separates the common renderer contract from backend adapters without cyclic or private-backend leakage, and host, Vulkan and Metal contract builds remain covered.
